summary: No advisory committee was convened for NDA 022129 (ULESFIA, benzyl alcohol lotion 5% for head lice). The Summary Review and Medical Review both state no AC was held, and the Office Director memo explains the application was not presented to the Dermatology and Ophthalmology Drugs Advisory Committee because systemic exposure to benzyl alcohol following topical treatment was low and no concerning safety signals were documented. With no committee, there are no AC-driven linkages to the approval.
